source.title: Koncert Thompsona i vodećih pjevača duhovne glazbe

summary.title_hr: Koncert Thompsona i vodećih pjevača duhovne glazbe
summary.abstract_hr: Humanitarni koncert "Hrvatska za Život" u Sisku okupio je brojne izvođače i publiku u svrhu podrške trudnicama, majkama i kulturi života. Događaj je istaknut kao duhovna obnova i prilika za zajedništvo, s naglaskom na važnost javnog svjedočenja vjere i pro-life poruke. Sudionici su izrazili zadovoljstvo i ponos što su dio inicijative koja se bori za svaki život, a vrhunac večeri bio je nastup Marka Perkovića Thompsona.
key_points: Humanitarni koncert "Hrvatska za Život" u Sisku uspješno je okupio brojne izvođače i publiku s ciljem podrške trudnicama, majkama i kulturi života.
Sudionici su izrazili duboko zadovoljstvo i ponos što su dio plemenite priče, ističući važnost pomaganja i širenja svijesti o vrijednosti svakog života od začeća do prirodne smrti.
Koncert je doživljen kao snažna duhovna obnova i prilika za zajedničku molitvu, naglašavajući da se vjera ne smije živjeti tajno, već javno svjedočiti i dizati glas za nerođene.
Udruga "Hrvatska za Život" prepoznata je kao ključna u brizi za začete živote i pružanju podrške obiteljima, a koncert je kruna njihovog predanog i požrtvovnog rada.
Mnogi su istaknuli da je događaj potaknuo razmišljanje o životu i potrebi da se o toj temi otvoreno govori, te da se pruži podrška majkama koje su u nedoumici.
Marko Perković Thompson, kao vrhunac večeri, svojim je nastupom dodatno obogatio atmosferu zajedništva i ponosa među okupljenima, izvodeći jedanaest pjesama.
Cilj koncerta je bio i potaknuti supružnike da se odluče za život više, jer se "Hrvatska voli djecom".
summary.title_en: Concert of Thompson and leading singers of spiritual music
summary.abstract_en: The humanitarian concert "Hrvatska za Život" in Sisak gathered numerous performers and the audience for the purpose of supporting pregnant women, mothers, and the culture of life. The event was highlighted as a spiritual renewal and an opportunity for communion, with an emphasis on the importance of public witnessing of faith and the pro-life message. The participants expressed satisfaction and pride in being part of an initiative that fights for every life, and the peak of the evening was the performance of Marko Perković Thompson.
key_topics_en: the importance of family and motherhood
key_points_en: The humanitarian concert "Hrvatska za Život" in Sisak successfully gathered numerous performers and the audience with the aim of supporting pregnant women, mothers, and the culture of life.

The participants expressed deep satisfaction and pride in being part of a noble story, emphasizing the importance of helping and spreading awareness of the value of every life from conception to natural death.

The concert was experienced as a powerful spiritual renewal and an opportunity for joint prayer, emphasizing that faith must not be lived in secret, but publicly witnessed and raising one's voice for the unborn.
The association "Hrvatska za Život" is recognized as key in the care for conceived lives and providing support to families, and the concert is the crown of their dedicated and self-sacrificing work.
Many pointed out that the event stimulated reflection on life and the need to speak openly about this topic, and to provide support to mothers who are in doubt.
Marko Perković Thompson, as the peak of the evening, additionally enriched the atmosphere of communion and pride among those gathered with his performance, performing eleven songs.
The goal of the concert was also to encourage spouses to decide for life more, because "Croatia is loved with children".
